meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 帮你把消息渠道（如 Slack、Telegram 等）接到 agent 组上，决定隔离级别，新增渠道组，并随时显示哪些渠道已接好、哪些还没配。
howto.when: 在你新增渠道之后、初始化设置过程中，或想单独重新配置渠道接线时接管。

say.text: 把新加的 Telegram 群接到现有 agent 组上
say.note: 会先问隔离方式，再注册接线

say.text: 看下现在哪些渠道已接好、哪些还没配
say.note: 输出渠道与 agent 组的配置摘要

say.text: 把这个渠道从旧的 agent 组移到新的组
say.note: 删除旧接线并新建一条

howto.what_en: Wires messaging channels to agent groups, sets isolation levels, adds new channel groups, and shows which channels are wired or not.
howto.when_en: Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure channel wiring.

say_en.text: Wire the new Telegram group to my existing agent group
Show which channels are wired and which aren't
Move this channel from its old agent group to a new one
say_en.note: Deletes old wiring, creates a new one
